s01b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s01b02.text: So, I was having a memory.

s01b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s01b03.text: About the first story I ever wrote about my emotions.

s02b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s02b01.text: And I was inside my mind.

s02b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s02b03.text: And my fear kept pulling the fire alarm.

s03b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s03b01.text: So I imagined myself as the CEO of my mind.

s04b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s04b01.text: It turned out it was the void.

s04b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s04b02.text: A huge, intimidating presence, standing in the back of my mind.

s04b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s04b04.text: And its face was pure darkness.

s06b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s06b01.text: So it kept pulling the alarm, having panic attacks.

s06b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s06b06.text: Forcing all the emotions out of my mind.

s07b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s07b01.text: Then one day, I put my hand on my fear's shoulder.

s07b04.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
s07b04.text: You need to stop pulling the fire alarm.

s09b02.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
s09b02.text: Fear, we need to put you in a time-out.

s09b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s09b03.text: So, I put my fear into a cage.

s09b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s09b04.text: And it cried, and shook, and pulled at the bars.

s10b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s10b01.text: And the void stood there. Stone-faced.

s10b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s10b02.text: Its dark shadow, filling so much of the room.

s11b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s11b01.text: Then, when I wasn't looking, I had an image in my mind.

s11b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s11b02.text: Of the void, taking its hand, and unlocking the cage.

s12b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s12b01.text: When my fear saw the open cage, it froze.

s12b05.speaker: FEAR
s12b05.text: This is a trick. This can't be right.

s12b07.speaker: NARRATOR
s12b07.text: But the void just stared, off into the distance.

s13b03.speaker: FEAR
s13b03.text: Why are you just standing there?

s13b04.speaker: FEAR
s13b04.text: Are you just here to scare me forever?

s13b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s13b06.text: And the void did not move. It stood there.

s14b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b01.text: But then, the void turned its gaze toward my fear.

s14b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b03.text: It thought the void had had enough of its complaining, and would destroy it.

s14b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b04.text: So it hid its head in its hands.

s15b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s15b01.text: But then, my fear felt a hand on its shoulder.

s15b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s15b03.text: And it looked up, into the face of the void.

s16b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b01.text: And instead of pure darkness, it saw the twinkling of lights.

s16b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b02.text: Like galaxies, and nebulae, and stars of the universe.

s16b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b03.text: The void, filled with bits and pieces of meaning.

s16b05.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b05.text: And my fear had tears in its eyes.

s17b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s17b01.text: Instead of feeling like it would get hurt, it felt wonder, and amazement.

s17b02.speaker: FEAR
s17b02.text: Why are you showing me this?

s17b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s17b04.text: The void took its hand away, and stared into the screen of my consciousness.

s18b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s18b01.text: And when my fear looked there too, my other emotions were looking back.

s18b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s18b04.text: They smiled, just briefly, then went back to work, helping my consciousness.

s19b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s19b01.text: And my fear wiped the tears from its eyes.

s19b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s19b02.text: Then it felt a gentle push, toward my emotions.

s20b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b01.text: And fear looked over its shoulder, at the void.

s20b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b02.text: The void stood there, with galaxies twinkling in its dark facade.

s20b05.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b05.text: And went back to my other emotions, to help me.

s21b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s21b01.text: Then I saw the old cage.

s21b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s21b02.text: The gate was rusted, and hanging open.

s21b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s21b03.text: But that was just a small detail.

s22b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s22b01.text: Because the scene changed, to my emotions pressing the console buttons.

s22b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s22b02.text: And the void, standing in the background.

s22b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s22b03.text: And the rusty time-out cage, barely visible, in the back of my mind.

s23b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s23b02.text: After that, I may have shed a tear or two myself.
